name: H5N1 bird flu
value: US H5N1 death (1 Nov); no human spread
summary: Washington State reports first US H5N1 death of 2026; no person-to-person spread
state: A Washington State resident exposed to infected dairy cattle died of H5N1, health officials said on 2 Nov; the CDC rates the risk to the public as low and found no sign of person-to-person spread (CNN). Contacts are being monitored. Cases remain sporadic and animal-linked as of 4 Nov.
for_you: Follow UKHSA and CDC advice: avoid contact with sick or dead birds and unpasteurised milk.

sources.title: CNN — Washington reports first US bird flu death of 2026

why: H5N1 is the flu strain scientists most fear could become a pandemic; it has spread to mammals and dairy cattle.
drivers: Human cases, mammal-to-mammal spread, mutations, surveillance.

rubric.watch: Human clusters under investigation, rising human cases, or new mammalian species spread.
